A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SimplePoster and contain readable main text, equations, six tables, seven figures and Appendices A–F. The relocated appendices and references can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, human ratings, subject-extension and CPE ablations, and Japanese/Korean generalization experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–6 and the main-text and appendix qualitative comparisons.

M1.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 retain the FLUX-Fill/Qwen2.5-VL framework, full DiT fine-tuning, character-position encoding and flow-matching objective. The Appendix B adaptation and inference procedure also remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same e-commerce training data, product-poster benchmark with Chinese promotional text, and Japanese/Korean text-to-image data in Appendix B. The new citations introduce no evaluated datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1–6 and the qualitative comparisons. Table 2 retains FLUX-Kontext(pro), Step1x-Edit, Gemini 2.5 Flash, SeedEdit3.0/DreamPoster and PosterMaker; the SeedDream4.0 evaluation footnote is also retained.

E3.justification: The 500-image benchmark, 200 text-bearing examples, 1024×1024 resolution, evaluation metrics, five-annotator ratings and training budgets remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the same LoRA training and CPE-disabled inference protocol.

E4.justification: The CPE ablation, data-scale/epoch study, multilingual single-line versus multi-line analysis, subject-extension comparisons and failure cases are retained. Moving the supplementary material adds no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 retain their numerical entries, including SimplePoster's 98.7% subject preservation, 0.7133 sentence accuracy and 0.8062 NED in Table 2. Qualitative examples, rankings and reported trends also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The task formulation and character-coordinate construction in Equation (1) are unchanged. No mathematical definitions, derivations, assumptions or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion preserve the same claims about suppressing subject extension through full fine-tuning, controlling text layout through CPE, and achieving strong performance without auxiliary controllers.

C2.justification: The domain-gap and spatial-ambiguity explanations, visual-quality tradeoffs and Appendix A limitations are retained. Appendix E also preserves the qualification that automatic fidelity metrics may miss fine-grained errors.

D1.justification: The abstract's repository address changes from Alibaba-YuFeng/SIMPLEPOSTER to Alibaba-VELLDEPTH/SIMPLEPOSTER. Implementation details remain unchanged, and both versions describe resource release in future tense; the PDFs do not establish changed availability.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds a broad diffusion-progress sentence citing TC-Padé, Diffusion Probe, ShoeFit, Erase Diffusion and Attentive Eraser. The supplement adds a Yuvion VL team-report note. These six references expand context without revising the central positioning against poster-generation methods.

P1.justification: v2 adds two short contextual passages, updates the affiliation to Yuvion Team, Alibaba Group, and moves references after the supplementary material. The scientific narrative otherwise remains unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds Alibaba Security/Yuvion headers and page numbering, relocates the supplementary pages before the references, and introduces limited text and table-position reflow. Figure contents, table structures and captions are retained.

improvement.justification: The method, empirical evidence, scientific explanations and limitations remain unchanged. The added contextual citations, updated repository address and modest presentation changes do not resolve an important deficiency or establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
